header: Drop-in helpers for the "holidayCompare" case in src/lib/employees/analytics.ts. Pure functions: I use no DB and no date library here, so you pass the current year in.

symbols.name: tenseVerb
symbols.sig: export function tenseVerb(year: number, nowYear: number): string
doc: The verb follows the year relative to today: past -> had, current -> has, future -> will have.

symbols.name: diffInWords
symbols.sig: export function diffInWords(a: number, b: number, yearB: number): string
doc: I state the difference in words, from yearA to yearB, never as a bare +/- sign.

symbols.name: compareTypeSentence
symbols.sig: export function compareTypeSentence( label: string, yearA: number, a: number, yearB: number, b: number, nowYear: number,): string
doc: Comparison for a single type, e.g. "Festival holidays: ...".

symbols.name: compareTotalSentence
symbols.sig: export function compareTotalSentence( yearA: number, totalA: number, yearB: number, totalB: number, nowYear: number, parts: string,): string
doc: Comparison across all types. `parts` is the existing per-type breakdown string.
